decode.timed: the decode call alone, inside its process, into an output buffer written before timing
decode.verification: every decoded byte against the original, after timing

miniz_oxide.api: this bench's gzip framing around miniz_oxide::inflate::core::decompress

zipper.api: std::io::Read into the output, on a one-thread Rayon pool

zipper-all-threads.api: std::io::Read into the output, on the global Rayon pool

xpress-huffman.api: xpress_huffman::decompress per chunk, copied into the output

lzma.encoder: liblzma preset 6, LZMA-alone with an end marker

xpress.encoder: this bench's greedy encoder, 32 KiB chunks with one code each

zstd.encoder: libzstd level 3, one frame with its checksum
